name: Tome of the Cabal
summary: Horde warlocks seek the Tome of the Cabal's severed halves for Jorah Annison in the Undercity. Once kept in Lordaeron, the grimoire was torn apart and scattered across the world. Its damp, tattered remnants lie along hostile Eastern Kingdoms waters and deep in Kalimdor's centaur territory.

sections.title: A Divided Legacy
sections.body: The Tome of the Cabal once rested in the library of Lordaeron. Someone deliberately defaced the sinister grimoire, stripping away nearly half its pages and splitting it in two. The surviving formal text was bound for the dwarven halls of Ironforge, but the transport wrecked along the rocky coast west of Southshore. Its pages now rot in the shallows beneath the watch of scavenging murlocs.

sections.title: Scattered across Continents
sections.body: The vandalized half traveled far from Lordaeron to southern Kalimdor. Deep in Splithoof Hold in Thousand Needles, the Galak centaur hold the manuscript roughly. A warlock must search the damp Hillsbrad shoreline for the Moldy Tome, then enter the dusty, savage centaur canyons for the Tattered Manuscript. When both remnants reach Jorah Annison, the legendary dark text is restored to one readable volume.

faq.q: What is the Tome of the Cabal?
faq.answer: The Tome of the Cabal is an arcane grimoire of demonic rituals once kept in Lordaeron's capital. Someone defaced it and split it in two before it was lost across two continents.

faq.q: Why is one part of the book near Southshore?
faq.answer: After the tome was vandalized, its surviving bound portion was meant for scholars in Ironforge. The vessel carrying it wrecked on the coast west of Southshore, leaving the book stranded among local murlocs.

faq.q: How did the pages end up with the centaur in Thousand Needles?
faq.answer: Roughly half the pages were torn from the original tome in Lordaeron and smuggled away. Through trade, plunder, or wandering hands, the tattered manuscript eventually came to rest deep inside Splithoof Hold, where the Galak centaur keep it in a chest.
Jorah Annison is a Forsaken warlock in the Undercity's Magic Quarter. He guides rising Horde warlocks in recovering forgotten, forbidden lore to deepen their mastery of demonic forces.

faq.q: Who vandalized the tome in the first place?
faq.answer: Who vandalized the tome remains unknown. Jorah Annison laments the damage and wonders who could commit such an act against a text with such occult power.

faq.q: What does Jorah do with the book once you bring both parts back?
faq.answer: When you bring both the Moldy Tome and the Tattered Manuscript, Jorah Annison assembles them into one volume and reads its pages, preparing you for the next steps in your demonic rites.

angles.text: As a warlock, you reclaim the Tome of the Cabal as a rite of passage for an intermediate practitioner. Its lost Lordaeron arcana can expand your summoning repertoire.
As an undead, you recover a tome once kept in Lordaeron, before the kingdom fell. Its return reclaims occult heritage from your past human lives.
As Horde, you track the manuscript through the canyons of Thousand Needles. Horde forces at Freewind Post wage constant war against the native centaur.
